opening.text: I've been getting pain in my lower jaw and under my jaw for the last three months. It's a sudden, sharp, stabbing pain that only happens when I eat. Each episode lasts less than two minutes, and it's pretty bad, about an 8 out of 10. I should mention I wear dentures.
